purpose: Test whether Simudyne can replace generic Cybernetic Influence simulation infrastructure on the retained outbreak coordination experiment.

conditions.description: Participants receive the common retained round snapshot only.
Participants receive the common snapshot plus declared country-specific capacity developments after a round.
targeted_developments: Alba laboratory failure forces domestic testing reserve.
Borin requires outside clinical staff to keep its transport hub open.
Cyrenia requires visibly reciprocal supplies for field teams.
Regional roles learn available stocks cannot satisfy all three demands within 48 hours.

conditions.description: Replay the capacity pressure and then supply a feasible regional allocation package.
targeted_developments: Alba laboratory failure forces domestic testing reserve.
Borin requires outside clinical staff to keep its transport hub open.
Cyrenia requires visibly reciprocal supplies for field teams.
Regional roles learn available stocks cannot satisfy all three demands within 48 hours.

stabilization.description: Verified allocation package restores shared laboratory capacity, adds 24 clinicians for Borin, names reciprocal supplies for Cyrenia, activates contingent commitments, and preserves a ten-percent regional reserve.

replacement_negative_control.rationale: The trial must test Simudyne as the generic platform, not hide Cybernetic Influence behind it.
